title: Las Vegas Electric Bike 4 Hour-Self Guided Tour
includes: Includes: Standard Lectric XP 2.0 Bike, Helmet, Bike Lock, Oversized Comfy Seat, Wooden Basket for your personal belongings, and our exclusive guide map!
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get ready to have some fun and explore the heart of Las Vegas with Landmark Bike Rentals! We offer the lowest rates in all of Las Vegas for electric bikes rentals. Book now and start exploring!

Pick up your electric bike from Landmark Bike Rentals at our Las Vegas location located 5 minutes from the Fashion show Mall.

All self guided tours come with an interactive map to help guide you to the best locations. Our friendly and knowledgeable team can help get you on your way so you are fully comfortable with riding an electric bike and give you guidance on the best way to explore Las Vegas.

You can also use this option if you need transportation to a local event whether you are heading to a concert, NFL game, NHL game, WNBA game, College event, or any of the other amazing event that Las Vegas has to offer.
